# Implement Tdd

## Inputs

One dispatch packet, exact files, acceptance criteria, test commands, allowed side effects.

## Process

Read `AGENTS.md`, confirm the active lifecycle state and authority, inspect only relevant canonical artifacts, and make no assumption that is not supported by evidence or an explicit decision.

## Required output

Changed files, captured RED/GREEN/full-suite evidence, risks, next state.

Include artifact paths, traceability links, risks, evidence, owner, and recommended next lifecycle state.

## Stop conditions

Stop on scope expansion, unexpected existing failure, secret/permission prompt, destructive action, or contradictory artifacts.
